subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should experimental `claws remove` permanently delete completed active provenance without a tombstone while retaining shared plugins by default, or should the lifecycle keep redacted post-removal history and a different cleanup policy?
rationale: The branch intentionally chooses a product-level lifecycle contract after review comments requested different operator-recovery behavior; source review cannot determine which durable operator model OpenClaw should promise.

options.title: Confirm the scoped no-tombstone policy
options.body: Keep completed cleanup row deletion and default plugin retention, with partial subordinate provenance remaining only for failed cleanup.

options.title: Require durable redacted removal history
options.body: Add a bounded tombstone or equivalent recovery record before this lifecycle is accepted as the authoritative operator surface.

options.title: Resolve the RFC policy before landing
options.body: Pause this slice until the RFC records the accepted retention and shared-resource cleanup contract, then align the branch and proof with that decision.

recommendation.title: Resolve the RFC policy before landing
recommendation.body: Pause this slice until the RFC records the accepted retention and shared-resource cleanup contract, then align the branch and proof with that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment identifies the unresolved operator-facing lifecycle policy directly.
